dialogue.content: counted how many of these I actually own.
did a slow warm-up and nothing else.
sat in on a session at about my level. pleasant enough.
recorded it on my phone to hear it back.
ordered a part and forgot what it was for.
when I'm the strongest one in the room I stop following and start deciding. where it goes next is mine, for better or worse.
then I'm following whoever's leading. it's about being the strongest, not about the level.
did half an hour standing up for no reason.
compared two versions for far too long.
tuned everything and then went to bed.
watched a much better player for an hour without joining in.
showed someone the thing I'm proud of. they nodded.
did it while something was on in the background.
put a new string on and broke it immediately.
spent longer choosing what to work on than working.
everything I can do without being led came out of sessions where I was making the decisions. the sessions with better players I follow beautifully and retain none of it.
I can do it while they're there and not afterwards.
wrote the date on a thing so I'd remember when.
restrung it and immediately put it down again.
watched a tutorial all the way through without trying any of it.
reorganised the shelf by colour. took an hour.
